featured.title: Your Green Card Application Just Became 'Extraordinary' — What the USCIS Memo Means for 400,000 Indian Applicants
featured.excerpt: A May 21 policy memo reframes adjustment of status as an act of 'administrative grace.' For Indian professionals who have waited a decade or more, the shift from routine to exceptional could force them out of the country mid-application.
featured.image_caption: A new USCIS memo on 'extraordinary ability' could reshape green card applications for 400,000 Indian immigrants
featured.nri_angle: Indian green card applicants form the longest backlog in the employment-based system. This memo's push toward consular processing could force hundreds of thousands to leave the US — their jobs, homes, children's schools — to apply from India instead.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

editorial.title: From Memes to Monarchy: RCB's Dynasty Has Arrived
editorial.excerpt: Royal Challengers Bengaluru retain the IPL title with a five-wicket demolition of Gujarat Titans in Ahmedabad — and a 15-year-old from Sambalpur might just have stolen the entire season.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Four Players With Indian Roots Are at This World Cup. It Has Never Happened Before.
news.excerpt: From a Punjabi midfielder who trained at Bayern Munich to a 19-year-old Keralite winger in Qatar's squad, the diaspora is represented at football's biggest stage for the first time at this scale.
news.image_caption: Sarpreet Singh during training at FC Bayern Munich in 2019
news.nri_angle: Four players with roots in Punjab, Kerala and Tamil Nadu are representing New Zealand, Qatar, Australia and DR Congo at the World Cup — giving NRIs their closest connection to football's biggest tournament.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Nearly Missed the World Cup on Television. Zee Stepped In Ten Days Before Kickoff.
news.excerpt: After Reliance-Disney balked at FIFA's asking price and Sony walked away, Zee Entertainment secured an eight-year, $60 million deal that covers 39 FIFA events through 2034. Here is how to watch.
news.image_caption: A FIFA World Cup 2026 venue under preparation in the United States
news.nri_angle: NRIs can now share the World Cup experience with family back in India — Zee5 streaming and DD Sports free-to-air coverage ensure the access problem is solved, even if the midnight IST kickoff times remain.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Just Raised Cancer Drug Prices by 50 Per Cent. The Iran War Is in Every Chemo Ward Now.
news.excerpt: Platinum shortages caused by the Gulf conflict have dried up supplies of cisplatin and carboplatin — the first-line drugs for lung, ovarian and bladder cancers. The price hike may restart production, but not everyone will be able to afford it.
news.image_caption: A nurse prepares chemotherapy drugs for administration at a hospital
news.nri_angle: NRIs with elderly parents or family members undergoing cancer treatment in India face higher costs and persistent drug shortages at government hospitals.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Modi Leaves for Europe Tomorrow With the Longest Agenda an Indian PM Has Carried to a G7.
news.excerpt: Five days, two countries, one historic first and a fraught bilateral with Trump. From dead Indian sailors to H-1B visas to a trade deal deadline, here is everything on the table.
news.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, who departs for France on June 13
news.nri_angle: The Modi-Trump bilateral will directly address H-1B visa policy, trade tariffs on Indian goods, and energy cooperation — all issues that shape daily life for NRIs in the US.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: The Leaked Iran Deal Gives Tehran Almost Everything It Wanted. India's Oil Bill Depends on What Happens Next.
news.excerpt: A 14-point memorandum published by Iranian state media includes Hormuz reopening under Iranian control, $300 billion in reparations talks, and a 60-day nuclear deferral. Trump says the leak is fake. Oil has crashed to a two-month low.
news.image_caption: The Strait of Hormuz, through which a fifth of global oil shipments normally pass (Wikimedia Commons)
news.nri_angle: A deal that reopens the Strait of Hormuz would ease oil prices, strengthen the rupee, and slow the inflation that has pushed up the cost of flights, remittances and household budgets in India.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Foreign Investors Have Pulled $30 Billion From India This Year. BlackRock Says the Selling Has Gone Too Far.
news.excerpt: India has lost more foreign investment in six months than in any full year on record. The world's largest asset manager says the AI panic and oil fear have masked the real story.
news.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange in Mumbai, where foreign investors have pulled a record 0 billion from Indian equities this year (Wikimedia Commons)
news.nri_angle: NRI investors with Indian equity exposure face the core question: have markets bottomed after a record $30 billion outflow, or is more pain ahead? BlackRock's contrarian call and the RBI's NRI deposit sweeteners could shape the answer.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: TCS Just Partnered with the AI Company That Wiped $63 Billion Off India's IT Sector. It Plans to Give 50,000 Workers Access to Claude.
news.excerpt: The partnership comes after Anthropic's tools triggered a $62.8 billion market-cap wipeout in Indian IT. TCS's chairman says the company is moving towards equal numbers of AI agents and human employees.
news.image_caption: N. Chandrasekaran, chairman of Tata Sons and TCS, at a corporate event
news.nri_angle: Hundreds of thousands of NRI tech workers on H-1B visas at IT services firms face job uncertainty as their employers deploy AI agents to replace the very roles that brought them to America.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Kevin Warsh Chairs His First Fed Meeting Next Week. India Has $30 Billion Worth of Reasons to Watch.
news.excerpt: The new Fed chairman leads his first FOMC meeting on June 16 with US inflation at a three-year high, a possible Iran deal reshaping oil markets, and India's financial system hanging on every word.
news.image_caption: Kevin Warsh, the new Federal Reserve chairman, who chairs his first FOMC meeting next week (Wikimedia Commons)
news.nri_angle: NRIs face a direct trade-off between US and Indian deposit rates, while the Fed's decision on rates will affect everything from mortgage costs and tech-sector hiring in America to the rupee and foreign outflows from India.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India's Inflation Just Hit a New-Series High. The Iran War Is Now in Every Grocery Bill.
news.excerpt: Retail CPI rose to 3.93 percent in May after four fuel hikes. The RBI has raised its full-year forecast. Economists say 6 percent by December is no longer a tail risk.
news.image_caption: A market in India — food prices are surging as the Iran war disrupts supply chains (Wikimedia Commons)
news.nri_angle: Rising Indian inflation erodes the purchasing power of remittances — the rupee at 95 per dollar means money sent home buys less in real terms, while RBI rate hikes would slow the economy the diaspora invests in.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: A Federal Judge Just Killed Trump's $100,000 H-1B Fee. Indians, Who Get 75% of All Approvals, Have the Most to Gain.
news.excerpt: The Boston ruling calls it an unconstitutional tax. The White House says it will appeal. A Republican lawmaker wants Congress to impose the fee itself.
news.image_caption: The John Joseph Moakley United States Courthouse in Boston where the H-1B fee ruling was issued
news.nri_angle: Indians receive over 70% of all H-1B approvals — the $100K fee had priced thousands of Indian professionals and their employers out of the programme, and its removal is the biggest immigration relief for the diaspora in months.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Just Summoned America's Top Diplomat for the Second Time in Three Days. The Relationship Has Not Been This Strained in Years.
news.excerpt: Two diplomatic protests in 72 hours over attacks on Indian-crewed ships mark the sharpest public rebuke New Delhi has delivered to Washington in the modern partnership.
news.image_caption: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar whose ministry summoned the US deputy chief of mission in New Delhi twice in three days
news.nri_angle: The India-US strategic partnership underpins visa programmes, defence deals, and tech investment flows that directly shape the lives of four million Indian Americans — a diplomatic crisis of this magnitude puts the broader bilateral agenda at risk.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Puts All Maritime Agencies on 'Heightened Alert' After Three Tanker Strikes in Five Days
news.excerpt: The shipping ministry directive comes as trade unions demand answers, 300,000 Indian seafarers work on vessels worldwide, and New Delhi summons the US diplomat for a second time in three days
news.image_caption: INS Vikrant, India's first domestically built aircraft carrier — the country has placed all maritime agencies on heightened alert (Wikimedia Commons)
news.nri_angle: India supplies the largest merchant marine workforce in the world — over 300,000 seafarers — and many NRI families have relatives working on commercial vessels in the volatile Gulf region.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Trump Claims a Secret Oil Mission Moved 100 Million Barrels Through Hormuz. His Energy Secretary Says He Knows Nothing.
news.excerpt: The contradiction between the president and his own cabinet underscores the opacity of the Strait of Hormuz situation — and India, which imports 85% of its crude, needs clarity more than anyone
news.image_caption: US President Donald Trump at the White House
news.nri_angle: India imports 85% of its crude oil and was the destination for a large share of Hormuz throughput — the truth about what is actually getting through the Strait directly determines Indian energy bills and inflation.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: EY, Deloitte and a Space Startup All Opened AI Centres in Bengaluru This Week. The Pattern Is Clear.

news.nri_angle: Bengaluru's AI hiring boom is creating high-paying roles in AI engineering, digital twins, and immersive design that could accelerate the reverse brain drain — giving NRI technologists in the US and UK a reason to consider moving back.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India's Dead Sailors Have Put Modi in a Corner. He Meets Trump at the G7 Next Week.

news.title: Sensex Surges 1.2%, Rupee Set to Rally as Oil Crashes to Two-Month Lows on Iran Deal Hopes
news.excerpt: All sixteen sectors in the green, Brent at $88.55, but Tehran says it has not signed anything yet — and IT stocks keep falling.
news.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai — the Sensex surged over 1.2% on Friday as oil prices crashed (Wikimedia Commons)
news.nri_angle: A weaker rupee boosts NRI remittance purchasing power but signals economic stress — a genuine Iran deal would stabilise the currency that shapes how far diaspora money stretches back home.

news.title: India Just Waived Seven Years of Nuclear Import Duties. The Iran War Made It Urgent.
news.excerpt: A finance ministry order retroactively clears customs on reactor equipment back to 2019 and extends duty-free status through 2035, signalling that energy independence has become a national security priority.
news.image_caption: The Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant in Tamil Nadu — India has waived seven years of nuclear import duties (Wikimedia Commons)
news.nri_angle: NRI engineers have been central to India's nuclear programme, and the country's energy mix directly affects cost of living and economic growth back home.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Trump Says Iran Deal Is 'All Wrapped Up.' India Is Not Celebrating Yet.
news.excerpt: The US president says a signing could come this weekend and the Strait of Hormuz will reopen. Oil has already crashed below $87. But Tehran says it has not agreed to anything.
news.image_caption: US President Donald Trump at the White House
news.nri_angle: A deal reopening the Strait of Hormuz would crash oil prices, strengthen the rupee, ease inflation for NRIs in the Gulf, and reduce the risk to 300,000 Indian seafarers working in global shipping.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Three Bay Area Hindu Temples Hit in Weeks. All Five Indian-American Lawmakers Just Demanded Answers.
nri-world.excerpt: In an unprecedented move, every Indian-American member of Congress has written jointly to the DOJ after a wave of pro-Khalistan vandalism struck temples from Hayward to Newark. The State Department and India's foreign minister have also weighed in.
nri-world.image_caption: A Hindu temple in California, representative of the community institutions being targeted
nri-world.nri_angle: Hindu temples in the Bay Area — the heart of the Indian-American tech community — are being systematically targeted, prompting an unprecedented joint response from all five Indian-American members of Congress.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Fifty-Six Years After a Prayer at Le Bourget, France Is Getting Its First Traditional Hindu Temple
nri-world.excerpt: The BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir in Bussy-Saint-Georges opens in September with a thirteen-day Festival of Culture — a milestone for Europe's Indian diaspora that began with a 1970 airport layover.
nri-world.image_caption: Carved stone deities at a traditional Hindu temple — the same craft tradition behind the Paris mandir
nri-world.nri_angle: The Paris mandir fills a gap for hundreds of thousands of Indians across Western Europe who have lacked a traditionally built stone temple, and its September inauguration is already drawing NRI families from the US, UK, and Gulf into pilgrimage-tourism packages.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Singapore Just Blocked Fourteen Posts Targeting Its Indian Community. The Content Likely Came from China.
nri-world.excerpt: The city-state invoked its Online Criminal Harms Act to order YouTube, Facebook, and X to disable videos claiming Singapore was being 'overrun by Indians' — a rare, swift use of state power to defend diaspora communities.
nri-world.image_caption: A street in Little India, Singapore, adorned with colourful cultural decorations
nri-world.nri_angle: Singapore's decisive legal intervention to protect its Indian minority offers a sharp contrast to how other countries with large NRI populations have responded to anti-Indian sentiment — and raises questions about what legal tools are available elsewhere.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Seven 'Ratnas' and a 57-Year Legacy: Inside the AIA-NY Annual Benefit Gala 2026
nri-world.excerpt: The oldest Indian-American organisation honoured a xenotransplantation pioneer, a Harvard AI entrepreneur, and five other trailblazers at a packed Flushing gathering — then announced plans for its 39th Deepavali celebration.
nri-world.image_caption: The Association of Indians in America held its annual gala at Terrace on the Park in Flushing, New York
nri-world.nri_angle: Oldest Indian-American organisation (founded 1967) honours new generation of NRI achievers; event bridges generational and professional divides in the community.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Coming Home to Concrete: How the Gulf War Is Fuelling a Kerala Property Rush Among NRIs
nri-world.excerpt: Four months of conflict in West Asia have pushed Gulf-based Keralites to hedge their futures with flats and plots back home — even as construction costs surge 35 per cent and builders struggle to keep up.
nri-world.image_caption: New residential developments in Kochi, Kerala, where NRI property demand has surged amid the West Asia conflict
nri-world.nri_angle: Gulf-based Keralite NRIs — one of India's largest remittance communities — are reassessing permanent settlement plans; war is accelerating a generational shift from 'earn abroad, retire home' to 'invest now, return sooner.'
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: American India Foundation Raises Record $3.8 Million at 25th Anniversary Gala in New York
nri-world.excerpt: The milestone evening at Cipriani Wall Street honoured Infosys CEO Salil Parekh, retired TD Bank chief Bharat Masrani and BNY — with over $1 million pledged from the floor in a single night
nri-world.image_caption: A gala event hall set for a formal philanthropic dinner
nri-world.nri_angle: AIF's quarter-century record demonstrates the maturing financial muscle of Indian-American philanthropy — channelling diaspora wealth back into education, health and livelihoods across 35 Indian states and union territories.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: UAE Arrests 19 Indian Nationals for Spreading Fake Missile Videos Amid Gulf Tensions
nri-world.excerpt: As the Iran-US conflict enters its fourth month, Dubai authorities crack down on misinformation — and the diaspora's largest Gulf community finds itself caught in the crossfire
nri-world.image_caption: The Dubai skyline — home to the UAE's largest concentration of Indian expatriates
nri-world.nri_angle: With 3.5 million Indians in the UAE — the single largest expatriate community in any Gulf state — the arrests are a sharp reminder of how wartime information laws can ensnare diaspora workers unfamiliar with local legal thresholds.

nri-world.title: Indian-Origin Teen Gurnoor Kaur Wins Canada's National Data Science Contest With AI Wheat-Disease Model

nri-world.nri_angle: Kaur's win adds to a growing roster of Indian-origin students excelling in North American STEM competitions — part of a second-generation pattern where children of immigrants leverage parental emphasis on education into nationally recognised research.

nri-world.title: 'Let Me Cook and Feed People': An Indian Woman's Response to Belfast's Anti-Immigrant Violence

nri-world.title: The Wait Gets Longer: EB-2 India Retrogression Rattles Thousands of NRI Professionals

nri-world.image_caption: Indian-born professionals across America face renewed uncertainty after the June 2026 Visa Bulletin
nri-world.nri_angle: Green card backlog directly impacts NRI professionals' career mobility, home ownership, and long-term family planning in America
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: From Temple Weddings to Pickleball Courts: TANA Is Rewriting the Telugu Diaspora Playbook

nri-world.title: Two Indian American Lawmakers Are at the Centre of America's State-Level Fight Over ICE
nri-world.excerpt: Nikil Saval in Pennsylvania and Ravinder Bhalla in New Jersey are drafting legislation to limit federal immigration enforcement in state institutions — placing diaspora politicians at the sharp end of the debate.

carousel.title: India's Gold Tariff Gamble: A 15% Import Duty, a $14 Billion Smuggling Surge, and the NRI Caught in Between
carousel.excerpt: New Delhi's bid to curb gold demand and protect forex reserves has revived grey-market channels that could move over 100 tonnes this year.
